title: Social Publishing Manifest
description: DC-003-I027 — the approved, platform-specific publishing instruction the Social Publisher Service executes exactly, never infers. This schema represents ONLY an already-approved manifest (`approval.approved` is fixed `true`) — there is no draft/review lifecycle here, unlike the Carousel Approval workflow's own approve/reject state machine; a manifest that hasn't been approved is simply not yet a valid instance of this object. No repository object anywhere in DC-003 currently stores Instagram captions or LinkedIn commentary (confirmed by repository investigation, not assumed) — this schema is the deliberate answer to that gap, not an automatic ingestion of Cowork/Google Docs content, which remains explicitly out of scope. Carries no platform credentials and no raw image data — only the identifiers linking it to an approved Finished Carousel/Production Asset Package, and the approved copy itself.

approval.description: Publishing-copy approval — a SEPARATE gate from the Finished Carousel's own I014 approval. Carousel approval is never treated as approval of captions or platform copy (per the I027 brief); the Social Publisher Service requires both independently.

destinations.description: At least one destination must be enabled. An enabled destination's own copy field is required and non-empty — enforced per-destination below, never inferred or defaulted.
